recent_works.title: Development of Multiscale Simulation Method for Oxygen Ion Conduction Analysis in Dual-Phase Solid Oxide Membrane
recent_works.abstract: In recent years, global warming has become increasingly serious, causing a variety of environmental problems around the world. Because the increase in CO 2 emissions is the reason for the global warming, some efforts are being made to achieve carbon neutral. In today's energy-consuming society, the impact of CO 2 emissions from thermal power generation, which accounts for most of the power generation, on global warming cannot be ignored. Therefore, fuel cells are attracting attention as a clean energy device because they do not emit carbon dioxide during the power generation process. Solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) have one of the highest operating temperatures (about 1000 K) among fuel cells and the associated high power generation efficiency. On the other hand, due to its high operating temperatures degradation of the solid oxide membrane (SOM) is accelerated. Therefore, one of the problems in SOFC development is to maintain high power generation efficiency while suppressing SOM degradation. recent_works.title: Molecular Dynamics Study of Oxygen Diffusion in Dual-Phase Solid Oxide Membrane
recent_works.abstract: The interface resistance between cathode and electrolyte in solid oxide fuel cell is the crucial factor for the performance. Although the cathode of (La, Sr) MnO 3 (LSM) creates a stable interface with yttria stabilized zirconia (YSZ) electrolyte, the chemical activity of LSM is lower than that of (La, Sr) CoO 3 (LSC) or (La, Sr)(Co, Fe)O 3 (LSCF). However, at the interface between YSZ and LSC (YSZ/LSC) or YSZ and LSCF (YSZ/LSCF), SrZrO 3 and/or La 2 Zr 2 O 7 are produced, which show high resistance. Therefore, CeO 2 material is inserted to the interface as intermediated. However, this insertion of CeO2 material also creates solid layer of (Ce,Zr)O 2 , which shows high resistance. Therefore, comprehending the oxygen ion conduction phenomena at the interface is important for reducing the resistance. Regarding the structure of membrane and interface, by applying the current nano-engineering technology, the thickness of membrane can be reduced to nanoscale and the interface structure can be manipulated in nanoscale. recent_works.title: Transformation of Classic English and American Literature into Children's Literature Using Artificial Intelligence
recent_works.venue: Asia-pacific Journal of Convergent Research Interchange
recent_works.abstract: This study aims to explore the possibility of transforming classic English and American literature into children's literature using artificial intelligence technology.Traditional classic literary works often contain deep themes and complex narratives, making them difficult for children to understand.This study investigates methods for converting Classic English and American literature into a child-friendly writing style using generative AI technology and creating illustrations to complement the text visually.Language models such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini were utilized for text generation, while image generation was conducted using Midjourney, DALL-E, and KlingAI.Experimental results showed that the Claude 3.5 Sonnet model generated the most natural and childfriendly sentences, and the 1-shot prompting method was identified as the most effective approach in the transformation process.Regarding image generation, DALL-E was selected as the most suitable model for producing illustrations appropriate for young readers.This study suggests the potential of AI technology to innovate literary education and proposes a new approach to providing children with a richer literary experien...

recent_works.title: Buffer-layer solid oxide fuel cells for direct-ammonia operation: An analysis of electrical performance and exhaust composition
recent_works.abstract: Hydrogen fuel is a very effective fuel source when the storage volume does not have strict space requirements. However, many applications of hydrogen fuel would be better served by a hydrogen carrier gas which requires a smaller storage volume for the same energy capacity. In many combustion processes, a hydrogen carrier such as ammonia would require a dedicated catalytic device to reform the ammonia into hydrogen for the combustion process. The use of solid oxide fuel cells (SOFC) may eliminate the need for a dedicated catalyst due to the inherent ability of the SOFC anode layer to carry out thermal cracking of ammonia. This work will discuss the performance characteristics of a direct-ammonia SOFC using the novel application of a SDC buffer-layer construction type. With a peak power density of 399mW/cm 2 at 750°C operational temperature, the direct-ammonia buffer-layer (DABL) SOFC has proven to be successful for ammonia operation in low temperature regimes. Additionally, this study highlights the exhaust composition obtained from direct-ammonia operation, with a key point of interest being the low nitric oxide content at low operational temperatures.

recent_works.title: A Design and Implementation CODA Service Application Based on Generative AI
recent_works.venue: Journal of the Korea Society of Computer and Information
recent_works.abstract: 본 논문에서는 생성형 AI 기반의 수어 번역 기능을 탑재한 CODA service 애플리케이션을 제안한다. 이 애플리케이션은 수어 번역 기술과 텍스트를 최소화한 사용자 인터페이스(UI)를 주요 특징으로 한다. 수어 번역 기술은 Image2Pose, Pose2Gloss, Gloss2Text, Image Generation 모듈로 구성한다. Image2Pose 모듈은 수어 영상을 입력받아 내용을 분석하고 이를 이미지로 변환하는 기능을 제공한다. Pose2Gloss 모듈은 연속적인 Pose 키 포인트를 입력받아 어떤 의미의 Gloss인지 번역하는 기능을 제공한다. Gloss2Text 모듈은 글로스를 텍스트로 변환하는 기능을 제공한다. Image Generation 모듈을 통해 텍스트를 이미지로 변환한다. 이 애플리케이션은 실제 사용자인 CODA를 대상으로 필드 테스트를 실시하고, 그 피드백을 바탕으로 수정 보완한다. 또한, 수어 추가 기능의 필요성을 확인하고, 이를 대조 학습(Contrastive Learning)을 활용하여 구현한다. 본 연구에서 제안하는 애플리케이션은 CODA 가족 간 원활한 소통을 지원할 뿐만 아니라, 수어 번역 기술 발전에도 기여할 수 있을 것으로 기대한다.
